notes: Inbound SMB — signed up from docs, trying to move from proof-of-concept to light production for support chat.
Primary workload: chat-based order-status + catalog FAQ. Also light semantic search for product content (embeddings later).
Traffic pattern: highly bursty — marketing emails and morning peaks. Average 5-8 rps, observed peaks ~60-80 rps in spike tests.
Latency target: p95 < 300ms for short-turn chat responses (truncate to 256 tokens). Cost sensitive: looking to keep monthly spend < $2k initially.
Key concerns: 429s during bursts, unclear client retry behavior, concurrency limits on API keys, and how quota resets/bursts are handled for self-serve accounts.
Asked for: per-api-key quotas, short window burst allowance, clear Retry-After headers, and suggested client-side backoff patterns (exponential jitter).
Requested POC: 2-week smoke test up to ~1M tokens, run two load profiles: (A) default batching, (B) limited concurrency + fallback to cheaper model when queue forms.
Security: SOC2 in progress; require SSO for admin console and 12-month audit log retention. No on-prem requirement.
Quote from CTO on call: "We need predictable behavior during campaign spikes — 429s are OK if graceful and documented."
Competitive note: evaluating pricing and latency vs OpenAI for cost-sensitive features; Anthropic for safety profile on chat.
Internal: AE/Jordan to get pricing deck + burst guide to prospect; SE/Maya to provide recommended concurrency settings and sample retry logic (client-side).
POC success criteria: <5% failed requests under simulated campaign spike with either auto-burst allowance or model-fallback; average cost per 1k tokens within estimate.
